legend: The well-circumscribed tumour consists of islands of tumour cells surrounded by lymphoid tissue and focally dense collagenous stroma. The ductal cells are large and polygonal, with abundant amphiphilic cytoplasm and minimal nuclear atypia, and show a cribriform to tubular architecture. Eosinophilic secretions filling cystic spaces are also observed.
